idea-plugin.name: QRLifetime QR Code Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Generate a QR code from a URL or any text without leaving the IDE, then insert it as SVG markup in the current file or save it as an SVG file in your project.

The QR code is generated locally with the open-source Nayuki QR Code generator library. The plugin makes no network request and collects no data.

How to use it

  1. Select a URL or some text in the editor, or leave the selection empty.
  2. Run QR Lifetime: Generate QR code from Find Action, the Tools menu or the editor context menu.
  3. If nothing was selected, type the URL or text in the dialog.
  4. Choose Insert SVG in the current file or Save as an SVG file in the project. Saved files go to the qr-codes folder at the project root.

The codes made by this plugin are static: the URL is written into the pattern itself, so they work forever but cannot be changed once printed. For QR codes whose destination you can edit later and that never expire, see qrlifetime.com.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.0: first release with the Generate QR code action.
